paragraphs.text: This Master Services Agreement (the “MSA”) is made on 1 April 2026 (the “Effective Date”) Between:
NEXORA SYSTEMS LIMITED, a company incorporated in England and Wales (No. 10482913), having its registered office at 14 Perivale Way, London EC2A 4BX (“Supplier”);

groups.section_opening: In this MSA, the following expressions have the meanings given below…

paragraphs.text: “Confidential Information” means all information disclosed by one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or by any other means, that is designated as confidential or that ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential.
“Deliverables” means the reports, software, documentation and other materials produced by the Supplier in the course of providing the Services.

groups.section_opening: The Supplier shall provide the Services with reasonable skill and care…

paragraphs.text: The Supplier shall provide the Services with reasonable skill and care and in accordance with each Statement of Work.
